blocks.text: The National Council on Disability Affairs (NCDA) urged the management of “Pinoy Big Brother” to promote greater disability sensitivity, after a viral clip showed some of the housemates allegedly “imitating speech characteristics associated with person with disabilities.” While the agency did not specify the particular incident it was referring to, it can be noted that several netizens have been calling out housemates Mikee Quintos and Cianne Dominguez after they supposedly mocked PWDs in two separate instances. don’t attack me ha ilang week na ako bothered kay mikee at cianne.
